name: Payment Card 34
definition: Electronic money product that provides the cardholder with a portable and specialised computer device, which typically contains a microprocessor.

Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of card, for example, credit card.

Number.name: Number
Number.definition: Number embossed on a card that links the card to the account owner and account servicer.

HolderName.name: Holder Name
HolderName.definition: Party entitled by a card issuer to use a card.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Year and month the card is available for use.

ExpiryDate.name: Expiry Date
ExpiryDate.definition: Year and month the card expires.

CardIssuerName.name: Card Issuer Name
CardIssuerName.definition: Party that issues a payment card, as expressed by a numeric identification of the card issuer according to ISO/IEC 7812-1.

CardIssuerIdentification.name: Card Issuer Identification
CardIssuerIdentification.definition: Party that issues a payment card, as expressed by a numeric identification of the card issuer according to ISO/IEC 7812-1.

SecurityCode.name: Security Code
SecurityCode.definition: Security code written on, or in, the card.

SequenceNumber.name: Sequence Number
SequenceNumber.definition: Number distinguishing two or more payment cards with the same account number.
